prompt.text:
Implement a two-dimensional viewport camera in `solution.rs` using only the standard library.

Expose `Vec2 { pub x: f64, pub y: f64 }`, `CameraError::InvalidParameter`, and `Camera2D`. `Camera2D` must provide:

- `pub fn new(center: Vec2, rotation: f64, zoom: f64, width: f64, height: f64) -> Result<Self, CameraError>`
- `pub fn set_pose(&mut self, center: Vec2, rotation: f64, zoom: f64) -> Result<(), CameraError>`
- `pub fn resize(&mut self, width: f64, height: f64) -> Result<(), CameraError>`
- `pub fn view_matrix(&self) -> [[f64; 3]; 3]`
- `pub fn projection_matrix(&self) -> [[f64; 3]; 3]`
- `pub fn world_from_ndc(&self, point: Vec2) -> Vec2`

Matrices are row-major and multiply column vectors `[x,y,1]`. The view matrix first translates the world by `-center`, rotates by `-rotation`, then scales both axes by `zoom`. Projection maps camera coordinates to normalized device coordinates with `x_ndc=2x/width` and `y_ndc=2y/height`. `world_from_ndc` must invert the combined projection and view transformations.

All supplied numbers must be finite; zoom, width, and height must additionally be strictly positive. Invalid construction returns an error. Invalid updates return an error without changing any field. NDC points may lie outside `[-1,1]`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
